title: Make me a bar chart of the top 10 companies in ...

querychat_viz_widgets.ggsql:
WITH matching AS (
  SELECT company
  FROM scout_postings
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%r%'
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualisation%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%tableau%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%power bi%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%powerbi%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%looker%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%ggplot%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%plotly%'
    )
    AND company IS NOT NULL
), top_companies AS (
  SELECT company, COUNT(*) AS postings
  FROM matching
  GROUP BY company
  ORDER BY postings DESC, company
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT company, postings
FROM top_companies
VISUALISE company AS y, postings AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Number of postings', y => 'Company'
